search_window.basis: Previous durable verified Care Line Watch completion through current local observation. Late-recall results checked for recency; production national collection remains authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: U.S., DC, Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa; hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary care losses and reopening, emergency/rural service losses, EMS/air medical closures, CMS terminations/rescissions/CLIA actions.

cms_public_notices.details: Official CMS Public Notices listing crawled October 26 shows last notices October 23; no fresh CMS termination, rescission, or CLIA change within this interval.

coverage_notes.screening: No credible U.S.-or-territory hospital/clinic/EMS loss, CMS access-risk action, or concrete essential-service reopening newly reported within the 07:07:05–observation interval. Results were dated substantially earlier or concerned plans, service-preserving situations, general policy, or foreign locations. Doylestown Hospital emergency-room disruption was reported Oct 22–23 (outside interval); not reintroduced as new. Papua New Guinea and Taiwan items excluded as outside jurisdiction.

duplicate_review.production_review: Production collector and review queue remain authoritative; no exhaustive production-wide history comparison for non-findings.

source_failures.error: Old CMS URL inaccessible via web fetch
source_failures.recovery: Current CMS Public Notices canonical page successfully obtained and inspected first via search result; notice coverage restored

coverage_notes.limitations: One redundant outdated CMS URL returned an access error while the current canonical CMS notice page was available, so technically DEGRADED with no material coverage loss. Date-limited search indexing and local-reporting latency mean no-findings does not prove no event occurred. Twelve web searches cap respected.
coverage_notes.controls: Supplementary recall only. No editorial approvals, posting, production-queue changes, schedule changes or disabling.
